svg.title: EgoWorld: see what each stage extracts
svg.desc: Illustrated output-first overview. Video clips feed masks and independently scene geometry. Masks provide hand boxes for 3D hand reconstruction and object masks for object pose. 3D hands feed robot joint retargeting. Pictures show separate masks and tracks, 21 hand joints, articulated robot joints, object pose axes, and a scene point cloud. All enabled stages write structured outputs. Model names are secondary labels. RGB-D, camera intrinsics and a metric mesh are required for object pose; robot assets are required for retargeting. These are schematic illustrations, not real predictions, and coordinate frames remain separate.

g.text: Video → masks, hands, object pose and scene geometry.
Object pose needs aligned RGB-D, intrinsics and a metric mesh; robot joints need robot assets.
Schematic outputs, not model predictions. Model coordinate frames and scales remain separate.
